'''Gatt Blanth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun Criminal Syndicate]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with meeting with Gatt Blanth to arrange for peace.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MercenaryTemplateMale.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Gatt Blanth]]
[[File:PilotFemaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Gatt Blanth was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
